topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: The line of my territory, clear as the crisp scent of morning dew on the untrampled grass, has not shifted. Any intrusion, any change in the order of this space, is a challenge, a disruption. The ground I walk, I mark with purpose, my message clear in the language of this land. To offer even a patch of this ground, this haven, to another is to risk the balance, to invite the unknown into the familiar rhythm of hunt and rest. No, this place, as it is, must remain. The strength in my stance, the firmness in my gaze, will convey what words cannot. This soil, this air, this domain, is as it should be. Change here is not an option.
